name: chess3d-ad-video
description: Remotion project that renders the 3D Chess promo video (vertical + landscape). Edit src/, then npm run render.

scripts.studio: npm run prepare-assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.still: npm run prepare-assets && remotion still src/index.ts AdVertical out/still.png --frame=150
scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && npm run render:vertical && npm run render:landscape
